steps: Where to look: Images, charts, logos and other objects with no text alternative (alt text).

blocks.title: Board/Q1 #2 – Überblick.docx — 3.1.1 · Language of Page
blocks.impact: Screen readers may pronounce the content in the wrong language.
steps: Where to look: The document’s default language is not set, so screen readers may use the wrong pronunciation.
macOS: Tools > Language > pick the document language and Set As Default (or Review > Language).
Windows: Review > Language > Set Proofing Language > choose the language > Set As Default.
blocks.recheck: Re-run the ACP assessment on the corrected copy: this finding must no longer be reported for WCAG 3.1.1.

blocks.title: sheets/budget.xlsx — 2.4.4 · Link Purpose (In Context)
blocks.impact: Link text does not say where the link goes when it is read out of context.
steps: Where to look: Links whose text does not say where they go (“click here”, “read more”, or a raw URL).
macOS: Review tab > Check Accessibility. Double-click a flagged item to jump to it, then use the fix in the Accessibility pane.
Windows: Review tab > Check Accessibility. Select a flagged item under “Inspection Results”, then apply the “Recommended Actions” shown.
blocks.recheck: Re-run the ACP assessment on the corrected copy: this finding must no longer be reported for WCAG 2.4.4.
blocks.stateReason: recorded by the current assessment and not resolved by any per-finding record

blocks.title: sheets/budget.xlsx — 1.3.1 · Info and Relationships
blocks.description: Check the header row is marked
blocks.impact: Screen-reader users cannot tell headings, lists or table headers apart from body text, so structure is lost.
steps: Where to look: Structure that is only visual — tables without header rows, text sized to look like a heading instead of using a Heading style.
macOS: Select the data range > Insert > Table (⌘T) and keep “My table has headers”. Give each sheet a real header row; avoid blank rows/columns inside data.
Windows: Select the data range > Insert > Table (Ctrl+T) and keep “My table has headers”. Ensure one clear header row per table.
blocks.recheck: Re-run the ACP assessment on the corrected copy: this finding must no longer be reported for WCAG 1.3.1.

blocks.text: What this report is, and is not

A record of what ACP detected, changed and re-verified across this scan against the WCAG 2.1 Level AA criteria in scope. It is not a conformance determination, a certification or legal advice; it can support an ADA, Section 508 or EN 301 549 / European Accessibility Act review as evidence alongside a qualified human evaluation.
